# Task (image generation only — do not edit any other files)

Use your image generation tool. Attach BOTH reference images to every generation: `ref_front.png` (3/4 front view, the creature faces lower-left) and `ref_back.png` (back view, seen from behind and slightly to the left). Both are enlarged low-resolution pixel sprites. Save the results exactly as:

1. `out/keys_2x2.png` — prompt A below
2. `out/sw_single.png` — prompt B below

Do not write or modify any other file. When both PNGs are saved, reply with their paths and the image sizes.

## Prompt A (2x2 key views)

Create a high-resolution 2x2 grid (1376x768) of authentic 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art monster sprites on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF). Turn the creature from the two attached reference images into crisp, detailed pixel-art sprites, keeping its exact design, proportions and colours. Do not add any part that is not in the references.

CRITICAL ANATOMICAL & DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS (MUST FOLLOW 100%):
1. Body: a very plump, round, pear-shaped bipedal electric mouse standing upright on exactly TWO short stubby feet. A big round head merges into a chubby wide body (no neck), exactly TWO small short stubby arms held in front of the belly, exactly ONE huge tail.
2. Colour palette (use only these families):
   - Body, head, arms and feet: lemon yellow (#F6E652) with pale yellow highlights (#FFF6A4), golden shading (#F6BD20) and ochre deep shading (#DE9400).
   - Outlines: crisp 1-2px outline in dark brown (#623108) and near-black (#101010), inner lines in brown (#9C5200). No anti-aliasing halo.
   - Ears: exactly TWO long pointed ears standing up and slightly outward, yellow with dark charcoal-grey tips (#41414A, #292929).
   - Face (front views only): two round black eyes with one white highlight each, a tiny dark nose, a small brown wavy mouth line, and exactly TWO round red cheek pouches (#C52018, light #E65A41).
   - Back (back views only): exactly THREE wide horizontal dark-brown stripes (#9C5200) across the back, one above the other.
   - Tail: ONE gigantic glowing lightning-bolt tail made of light: a pure white core (#FEFEFE) completely surrounded by a continuous, closed, bright lemon-yellow glow border (#F8FC4B with #FFF6A4), 3-4 px thick, so the white core never touches the white background. It grows from the lower back / rump, zigzags upward in sharp angular steps and ends in a large flat rectangular slab high above the head. The tail is taller than the body.
3. Counting rules: exactly two ears, exactly two arms, exactly two feet, exactly one tail, exactly two cheeks (front views), exactly three back stripes (back views). Never add extra limbs, ears or tails. Do not increase any count. No electricity effects, no sparks, no clouds, no aura around the body.

GRID LAYOUT (4 key poses, large and crisp, same scale, both feet on the same baseline):
- Top-Left: SOUTH (0°, front view) — facing straight toward the viewer, symmetric: both eyes, both red cheeks, the small mouth, both ears up, the two stubby arms in front of the round belly, the two feet below. The lightning tail rises behind the body on the right side and its big flat slab tip shows above the head.
- Top-Right: WEST (270°, left side profile) — facing LEFT in a sharp side profile: snout to the left, one eye, one red cheek, one ear in front of the other, one arm in front, the two feet (near and far), the round back on the right side, the lightning tail growing from the rump at the lower right and zigzagging up behind the body to a big slab above.
- Bottom-Left: NORTH-EAST (135°, back-right 3/4 view) — seen from behind and to the right, the face turned away to the upper right: the round back with the three brown stripes, the back of the head, both ears, the lightning tail rising from the rump and zigzagging up beside the body to the left, its slab tip above the head.
- Bottom-Right: NORTH (180°, pure back view) — seen straight from behind, like the back reference: the three brown back stripes, the back of the head, both ear tips, the two feet at the bottom, the lightning tail rising from the rump at the centre and zigzagging up to the left side with its slab above the head. No face visible.

## Prompt B (south-west single)

Create a single ultra-crisp 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art sprite (1376x768) on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF) of the same creature, matching the attached front reference image exactly in design, colours and pose: a very plump pear-shaped yellow electric mouse with two black-tipped long ears, two black eyes, two round red cheeks, a small brown wavy mouth, two small stubby arms in front of the belly, two short feet, and ONE gigantic lightning-bolt tail of white light with a continuous closed lemon-yellow glow border, zigzagging up behind the body on the right side to a large flat slab above the head.
View: SOUTH-WEST 3/4 quarter view, halfway between facing the viewer and facing left: the face looks diagonally down-left with both eyes visible in natural 3/4 perspective (not squished), both cheeks visible. Exactly two ears, two arms, two feet, one tail. Crisp 1-2px dark outline, limited palette, no anti-aliasing, no sparks or effects.
